text:
Type: long-hair sheepskin rug
Use: draping on a chair, bench or bed, or softening a floor spot; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, bohemian
Materials: natural sheepskin with long thick fleece
Colors: warm taupe brown, darker chestnut tips
Shape: organic hide outline with rounded lobes, deep shaggy fluffy wool, small and soft
Feel: cozy, warm, natural, inviting
Goes with: warm wood, leather, cream and rust textiles; rustic, cabin, Scandinavian or bohemian rooms
